title: City College: orders the notes call no bid or sole source
question: How many City College purchase orders do the notes describe as no bid, sole source, piggyback or emergency?
finding: Of 6,436 purchase orders read (2021-01-04 to 2025-08-29), 257 are marked "no bid" ($2,500,316) and 139 "sole source" ($4,652,107). Largest sole-source suppliers: Ellucian Company LLC $1,295,320; Pacific Auxiliary Fire Alarm Co. $1,053,521; Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise USA Inc. $238,294; an individual contractor $199,500. "No bid" appears mostly in the 2021 reports, on small supply orders; from 2023 the notes cite bids, piggyback contracts or sole-source files instead.
how: Words searched in each order's note; an order can carry more than one label. Amounts are the order amounts, which for yearly blanket orders are spending limits, not payments.
limits: Orders under the bid limit need no bid; piggybacking on another public agency's competitively awarded contract is a permitted route; sole source is permitted with a written justification, which is not in these reports. Note wording changed over the years, so year-to-year counts partly reflect wording.
